# Upnex It

> Upnex It is a software company in Naogaon, Bangladesh building School Management Software, Hospital Management Systems, custom software, and web applications for businesses across Bangladesh.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Upnex It and our software services.
- [About](/about): Company story, mission, vision, values, and leadership.
- [Mehedi Hasan — Founder & CEO](/about/mehedi-hasan): Background, education, and journey of co-founder Mehedi Hasan.
- [Arafat Rahman — Co-founder](/about/arafat-rahman): Background, education, and journey of co-founder Arafat Rahman.
- [Services](/services): All software services we provide.
- [School Management Software](/services/school): Digital school operations: admissions, results, fees, attendance, parent portal.
- [Hospital Management Software](/services/hospital): HMS for clinics and hospitals: patients, appointments, pharmacy, billing.
- [Custom Software Development](/services/custom): Tailor-made business software (ERP, CRM, inventory, e-commerce).
- [Web Development](/services/web): Modern responsive websites and web applications.
- [Portfolio](/portfolio): Selected projects we have delivered.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on software, technology, and business.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the Upnex It team.
- [Consultation](/consultation): Request a free project consultation.
- [Order](/order): Place an order for an Upnex It service.
